name: Fresh Honeydew Melon Slices
whyItWorks: Honeydew melon is over 90% water and provides naturally soft, smooth flesh with almost zero insoluble fiber when ripe. It is completely seedless in the edible portion and non-acidic, making it very gentle on inflamed intestines.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick ripe, fragrant melon with a slight give at the stem end. Cut away the rind generously and chew the pale green flesh thoroughly.
watchOuts: Avoid unripe, hard, crunchy melon that requires excessive mechanical digestive processing.
